title: Spouse Additions in a Disability Compensation Restoration
content:
**Clause.** The spouse addition in a restoration of Disability Compensation is the spouse addition plus the spouse aid-and-attendance addition when a spouse is recorded on the award and the most recent spouse addition is marked as needing aid and attendance; the spouse addition alone when a spouse is recorded and the most recent spouse addition is not so marked; and nothing when no spouse is recorded. Every month a restoration covers counts the spouse so recorded.

**Recorded spouse.** The spouse additions on the award less its spouse removals; the most recent spouse addition is the one with the latest effective date.

**Rates.** A restoration month priced from the 100 percent tier takes 220.30 for the spouse and 201.41 for aid and attendance; every other restoration month takes the award's own tier.

**Examples (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (70% Combined Rating), a month at the veteran-alone rate)**

- Spouse recorded, marked as needing aid and attendance: 154.21 plus 140.99, that is 295.20.
- Spouse recorded, not so marked: 154.21.
- No spouse recorded: nothing.
